profile.name: Jiangyu Liu
profile.subtitle: Undergraduate, Department of Automation, Tsinghua University

aboutMe: I am an undergraduate in the Department of Automation at Tsinghua University.

My research interests include visual representation learning, video generation, and embodied learning. I am interested in learning geometry and motion from visual observations and using these representations for robot action prediction and generalization. My recent work focuses on motion representations for world action models and stereo video VAEs.
Outside research, I enjoy table tennis and volunteering. Feel free to reach out for a game, a meal, or a conversation about research and volunteering!
campusExperienceLines: Selected coursework: Principles of Artificial Intelligence; Signals and Systems

Campus roles: Head of the Social Practice and Volunteering Group, Department of Automation; class president of the department's Tongban class; member of the Hardware Division of the department's Student Association for Science and Technology

items.title: Anyverse Dynamics | Algorithm Intern (Mar–Jun 2026)
items.text: Reproduced LoRA fine-tuning for π0 and inference pipelines for Fast-WAM and Motus. Profiled world action models to identify key computational paths and performance bottlenecks.

items.title: DISCOVER Robotics | Internship: Model Training & Evaluation (Jun–Sep 2026)
items.text: Conducted training and evaluation experiments for world action models augmented with motion representations, investigating ZipMo motion tokens and an auxiliary motion prediction loss in Fast-WAM. Also conducted stereo video VAE experiments on RGB reconstruction and disparity prediction, including training and small-dataset overfitting checks.

items.title: Tsinghua University AI Challenge | Reinforcement Learning Track
items.text: Compared PPO variants with rule-based strategies and designed decision rules based on game state and objectives. The rule-based strategy outperformed the trained PPO baselines; received the track Grand Prize (individual 1st Place).

items.title: ATEC 2026
